articles.title: Ledger asks resellers to halt sales in Southeast Asia and Hong Kong
articles.description: The wallet maker requested that devices be removed from shelves while investigators work to establish where tampering occurred.

articles.title: Most tokenized stock trading on Solana, BNB Chain occurs outside US market hours
articles.description: Tokenized equities have reached nearly $3.3 billion in value as investors embrace round-the-clock access beyond Wall Street hours.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Trezor reduces resellers as a ‘preventative step’ amid Ledger tampering reports
articles.description: CCO Danny Sanders said he had notified certain hardware wallet resellers that they would be removed from Trezor’s list of authorized entities starting Jan. 1.

articles.title: How the SEC’s lack of leadership could facilitate crypto rulemaking
articles.description: A recent change in the SEC’s rules on quorum could make it easier for the agency to amend its approach to crypto regulation in the absence of a market structure bill.

articles.title: Strive reports $208M in warrant exercises as Bitcoin holdings jump 11%
articles.description: Strive is now the fifth-largest publicly traded corporate Bitcoin holder, with 32,773 BTC, as it continues to expand its treasury through equity financing.

articles.title: Bitcoin keeps up pressure on $84K as US stocks skirt Korea tech sell-off
articles.description: Bitcoin price action preserved overnight gains as US stocks quickly rebounded after opening lower on the back of Korea’s tech-stock rout.

articles.title: Anthropic warns ‘AI worms’ may autonomously spread across devices like a virus
articles.description: Anthropic warned that rogue “AI worms” are months away from the ability to self-replicate and autonomously infect user devices such as home appliances and other internet-connected devices.

articles.title: Is Bitcoin kidding itself about the Lightning Network?
articles.description: Bitcoin developer Paul Sztorc says Bitcoiners are lying to themselves about Lightning. Developers claim usability has improved, but questions remain over everyday adoption.

articles.title: Digital cash offers ‘cash-like privacy,’ but bank data breaches threaten users: BIS
articles.description: BIS said that digital cash can achieve “cash-like privacy,” however, the technology isn’t yet production-ready due to risks such as bank data breaches.

articles.title: Russia clears Sberbank for crypto trading ahead of December launch
articles.description: Russia’s largest bank, Sberbank, has secured crypto exchange authorization as it prepares to offer Bitcoin, Ether and Tether USDt trading.

articles.title: ENS seeks DAO approval to activate upgraded Ethereum naming system
articles.description: New .eth registrations would pause for hours during the transition, while existing domain holders could renew their names without migrating.

articles.title: Metaplanet to issue $329M convertible bonds to pay debt, fund share buybacks
articles.description: Metaplanet plans to issue zero-interest bonds with a five-year maturity to improve its debt structure and cut its reliance on Bitcoin-collateralized loans without selling holdings.

articles.title: MediaMarktSaturn pulls Ledger products amid tampering reports
articles.description: European retailer MediaMarkt pulled Ledger products as the wallet maker probes tampering reports beyond CryptoBilis in Southeast Asia.

articles.title: Bitcoin hits $84K resistance as Korean tech rout deepens KOSPI losses
articles.description: Bitcoin’s liquidity kept BTC price below $84,000 amid a mounting South Korean tech and semiconductor stock sell-off.

articles.title: Chinese fraud victims lose key court battle over 61,000 Bitcoin
articles.description: Chinese fraud victims seeking to recover 61,000 seized Bitcoin face a legal setback after a UK court ruled that Chinese law governs their claims.

articles.title: Ledger details LTE-enabled spy implants in wallets sold by CryptoBilis
articles.description: Ledger detailed how LTE-enabled implants exposed wallet recovery phrases as CryptoBilis halted sales and Trezor and OneKey cut ties with the reseller.

articles.title: Blur is shutting down its website, so why are NFT collectors cheering?
articles.description: Blur’s planned website closure revived criticism of the royalty policies and token rewards that helped it overtake OpenSea during the NFT boom, but hurt creators.

articles.title: Binance to shut down crypto mining pool services in November
articles.description: Binance will discontinue its mining pool and related services on Nov. 10, urging miners to move to alternative pools before the shutdown.

articles.title: South Korea moves to block 27 crypto websites, including KuCoin, MEXC
articles.description: Authorities said the restrictions are aimed at unregistered exchanges and have acknowledged that customers could have difficulty withdrawing assets.

articles.title: Meta claims new Muse Wonder AI models rival OpenAI, Anthropic
articles.description: Meta co-founder Mark Zuckerberg said its newest models are a step toward “personal superintelligence.”

articles.title: Aptos rolls out Encrypted Mempool to curb frontrunning, sandwich attacks
articles.description: The optional feature hides transaction details until their order is finalized, preventing bots from exploiting pending trades.

articles.title: FTX’s crypto mining venture is now used to advance AI
articles.description: The defunct exchange acquired a 20% stake in Genesis Digital Assets before FTX declared bankruptcy in November 2022.

articles.title: Crypto PACs report $2.7M spending blitz on House races as midterms loom
articles.description: With just 22 days until the US midterm elections, a crypto-aligned committee has announced another major ad expenditure to support “pro-crypto” candidates in 2026.

articles.title: US accounting overhaul could make stablecoins more attractive to corporations: Tempo
articles.description: A Tempo report examines how proposed US accounting rules could change corporate stablecoin holdings, with direct redemption rights determining which tokens qualify as cash.

articles.title: Bitcoin miners face widening AI financing costs as lenders scrutinize deals
articles.description: The Bitcoin mining industry needs roughly $50 billion to complete planned AI infrastructure projects, with IREN, Riot Platforms and HIVE Digital facing major funding gaps.

articles.title: Bitcoin drops 2.2% as Ukraine, Iran strikes send oil toward one-month high
articles.description: Bitcoin price action stayed rangebound after failing to sustain above $84,000 into the Wall Street open on rising oil prices.

articles.title: XRP treasury Evernorth’s shares rise 5% at Nasdaq opening print
articles.description: Evernorth’s share price rose by 5% as investors welcomed the Nasdaq debut of the first pure-play XRP digital asset treasury.

articles.title: Ledger implant tests Bitcoin ETFs as safer custodial solutions than hardware wallets
articles.description: The discovery of an unauthorized Ledger hardware implant reignited debate on whether Bitcoin ETFs are safer than self-custodying Bitcoin via hardware wallet devices.

articles.title: Strategy adds 250 Bitcoin as holdings reach 848,250 BTC
articles.description: Michael Saylor’s Strategy said Bitcoin holdings reached 848,250 BTC after its latest purchase, while maintaining a $4.88 billion cash reserve.
